facts.text: The resort is set beside the Urubamba River along the Incan path, inspired by the ancient tambos that gave rest to travelers heading to Machu Picchu.
facts.excerpt: Set along the legendary Incan path, beside the flowing Urubamba River, Tambo del Inka draws inspiration from the ancient tambos that once offered rest and refuge to travelers on their journey to Machu Picchu.

facts.text: The hotel has a private train station with service to Machu Picchu.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel with a private train station to Machu Picchu provides an unforgettable journey between Urubamba and the famous Inca site.

facts.text: The train uses 1920s-style carriages, including a Dining Car and a panoramic Observation Bar Car.
facts.excerpt: Luxurious 1920s-style carriages—including a Dining Car and a panoramic Observation Bar Car—gourmet cuisine and the highest quality service all combine to create an unforgettable experience.

facts.text: Kallpa Spa features a thermal circuit, underwater beds, a couples massage room with Jacuzzi and relaxation rooms with starry ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Kallpa Spa features a thermal circuit, underwater beds, a massage room for couples with Jacuzzi, relaxation rooms with starry ceiling, a wide variety of treatments based on Inca ingredients, among others.

facts.text: Kallpa Spa offers treatments using traditional Incan ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Delight in a wide variety of treatments using traditional Incan ingredients at Kallpa Spa.

facts.text: The resort has a heated indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: rejuvenate at our spa, heated indoor pool, and fitness center

facts.text: Rooms look out on the Andes Mountains, the Vilcanota River or the resort gardens.
facts.excerpt: Take in views of the Andes Mountains, Vilcanota River or our resort gardens from your hotel room

facts.text: A number of suites have private balconies and terraces.
facts.excerpt: a number of suites providing private balconies and terraces

facts.text: Suites have wooden details and luxurious bedding.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel suites in Sacred Valley, Urubamba, will dazzle you with beautiful wooden details, luxurious bedding, and incredible views just outside your private balcony.

facts.text: All rooms and suites have Le Chemin bath amenities from BYREDO.
facts.excerpt: Pamper yourself with Le Chemin bath amenities from BYREDO, in all rooms and suites

facts.text: The resort has an onsite 2,000 square-meter organic garden producing vegetables, legumes and aromatic herbs.
facts.excerpt: Tambo del Inka features an onsite 2,000 m² organic garden producing organic vegetables, legumes, & aromatic herbs.

facts.text: Hawa Restaurant serves novo Andean cuisine featuring organic, homegrown ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy innovative novo Andean cuisine at our luxury hotel restaurant in Sacred...See More Valley, Peru, Hawa Restaurant, where organic, homegrown ingredients are featured in each and every dish.

facts.text: Kiri Bar has a gin menu, pisco-based drinks and a terrace with views of the Sacred Valley.
facts.excerpt: Savor an authentic Peruvian experience at our bar in Sacred Valley, Urubamba, Peru, featuring a gin menu, pisco-based drinks, and exquisite appetizers. Enjoy the terrace with views of the Sacred Valley

facts.text: In the Garden to Table experience, guests pick produce from the garden and cook with the chef on a wood stove on the banks of the Vilcanota river.
facts.excerpt: An experience that will allow you to participate actively in the picking of the best products of our garden in order to prepare them together with our chef in a wood stove on the banks of the imposing Vilcanota river.

facts.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge team members are bilingual, certified destination experts who wear the Les Clefs d'Or insignia.
facts.excerpt: Each Luxury Collection Concierge is a bilingual, certified destination expert, proudly wearing “Les Clefs d’Or,” the gilt insignia of the celebrated international concierge society

facts.text: The hotel suggests that its Sacred Valley location, at a lower altitude, is a good place to acclimatize.
facts.excerpt: located in the Sacred Valley, at a lower altitude, it is the perfect place to acclimatize

facts.text: Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport in Cusco is about 60 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near Tambo del Inka, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Valle Sagrado is Alejandro Velasco Astete International Airport (CUZ). CUZ is located approximately 60.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: Interiors weave ancient motifs into contemporary decor, including fireplaces sculpted out of Inca-style stone walls.
facts.excerpt: Designer Roberto Caparra’s imaginative interiors weave ancient motifs into the contemporary decor: towering fireplaces sculpted out of Inca-style stone walls, pre-Incan textile design reimagined as wallpaper, and oversized regional pottery.

facts.text: Accommodations face either the Urubamba River or the cordillera and the Chicon glacier.
facts.excerpt: Accommodations face either the Urubamba River or the cordillera and the Chicón glacier.

facts.text: The resort holds Biosphere Sustainable certification.
facts.excerpt: Through its Biosphere Sustainable certification and numerous additional initiatives of its own, the resort reaffirms its commitment to tourism that respects and enriches the Sacred Valley.

facts.text: The hotel says Kallpa Spa is considered one of the best spas in the country.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury Sacred valley hotel spa is considered one of the best spas in the country.

facts.text: Kallpa Spa has heated indoor and outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: Heated indoor and outdoor pools, whirlpools, Vichy and jet showers, sub-aquatic beds and hydrotherapy treatments are available.

contradictions.note: p1 spa section and p4 say heated indoor and outdoor pool(s); p1/p4 amenity listings list only an indoor heated pool

sources.excerpt: take a relaxing swim to soothe sore muscles in our heated indoor and outdoor pool
